title: Bounds Reporter
prompt: Implement `void bounds(const int* a, int n, int *mn, int *mx)` storing the smallest element into *mn and the largest into *mx (n >= 1), and `int pick(const int* p, int alt)` returning *p when p is non-NULL else alt.

tests.hint: Two scans or one — your choice.
